title: Mace Morningstar
body:
**Making the mace lovely instead of just a blast resistance block attached to the blue stick.**

**all the texture are made my me :3
give a credit for this if you are using it for your texture pack.**


Initially I wanted to make it look more harmful and dangerous but it turned out to be cuter than I expected.
